title: Product repository record
description: The product repository a control repository drives. Only what is the same on every machine; the local checkout path is configured per machine, never tracked.

name.description: Short product name, used in prose and in the default product worktree directory.

remote.description: Git URL of the product repository. Optional: a team whose URL must not be tracked sets product_remote in local.yaml instead, which overrides this. A product checkout whose origin differs from the resolved URL is refused.

integration_branch.description: The product repository's integration branch, which phase branches merge into.

ci_workflow.description: The forge workflow file the CI gate polls, or none.

github.description: The product repository on GitHub, as <org>/<repo>, for gh commands. Optional; product_github in local.yaml overrides it.
